caption:
🤖🕶️ Iron Man is helping Snapchat bring its futuristic smart glasses to life.
Snap, the company behind Snapchat, has teamed up with Robert Downey Jr., the actor who played Tony Stark, to introduce its new SPECS augmented reality glasses.
The glasses let users view virtual screens, control apps through hand gestures and voice commands, and use AI-assisted experiences. The goal is to bring digital experiences into the real world, changing how people work, learn, draw, and have fun without needing a smartphone.
Robert Downey Jr. will also take on an honorary role as Chief Customer Experience Officer, helping develop new features, content, and improvements.
The glasses start at $2,195, with preorders open and shipping planned for the US, UK, and France.
